fix: Load the JWT signing secret from an environment variable or secret manager, remove it from source and rotate it.
Use a parameterized query such as `WHERE title LIKE $1` with the value `'%' + q + '%'` passed in the params array.
Resolve the joined path and reject it unless it stays inside REPORT_DIR, or restrict the name with path.basename and an allow-list.
Hash passwords with a salted, slow algorithm such as bcrypt, scrypt or argon2 instead of MD5.
Validate the URL against an allow-list of hosts and block private, loopback and link-local addresses before fetching.
Require admin role or verify the ticket belongs to the requesting user before deleting.
Use execFile with an argument array and validate req.body.format against a fixed allow-list instead of interpolating into a shell string.
